encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: τὴν οἰκίαν γὰρ εὗρον εἰσελθὼν ὅλην

div.note: Pollux 10, 180 κίσται . . . καὶ αἱ τῶν φαρμακοπωλῶν ἂν καλοῖντο . . . ὥσπερ που καὶ Θεόπομπος ἐν Ἀλθαίᾳ κτλ. cf. Aristoph. fr. 28. 'Althaeae aedes dicere videtur magicis artibus Meleagri interitum aversurae. de pharmacopolis Megaricis aliunde nihil constat.' Meinek.

lg.l: φιάλην· Τελέστης δ’ ἄκατον ὠνόμαζέ νιν.

div.note: Athenaeus 11, 501f Θεόπομπος δ’ ἐν Ἀλθαίᾳ ἔφη κτλ. ὡς τοῦ Τελέστου ἄκατον τὴν φιάλην εἰρηκότος. Bekker. Anecd. 371, 5 ἄκατος· φιάλη, διὰ τὸ ἐοικέναι στρογγύλῳ πλοίῳ. οὕτω Θεόπομπος.

χρυσέαν Pierson. Moer. 413] χρυσέων. χρυσίων Valcken. Herod. 3, 130. Τελέστης Casaub.] τελεστής. ἄκατον Porson. Eurip. Med. 140, XII p. 408 ed. Lips.] ἄκρατον. ὠνόμαζέ νιν Porson.] ὠνόμαζεν ἵν A. tragici nescio cuius versus traduci formae χρυσέαν et νιν docent. Telestae Selinuntii (Diodor. 14, 46 extr.) fragmenta conlegit Bergkius in Poet. lyr. — risus ex eo captatur quod Telestes Althaeae sacrificio interfuisse dicitur: eam enim significari recte Meinekius monuit.
